subtitle: Natural Language Processing

keywords: Artificial Intelligence 2.Natural language processing 3.Neural network 4.Large Language Model 5.Experimental Semiotics
educationalGoal: Artificial Intelligence, which gives intelligence to machines and realizes human cognition and information processing, is becoming more and more important in various areas of ICT society. In this course, students will acquire basic knowledge and techniques of natural language processing, which is at the heart of artificial intelligence, and deepen their understanding of the characteristics of human languages and their differences.
advice: In this course, students will learn basic technologies and build and evaluate prototypes of applied systems based on them, based on an overview of the past and future of natural language processing. Through this lecture, students are expected to learn how to use the technical elements of natural language processing and how to realize services as a system by combining them, and to be able to evaluate the social problems and issues that these services may have. The lecture will begin with an introduction for beginners, so students are encouraged to deepen their understanding of the knowledge and techniques they already know. The content and level of the lectures will be adjusted flexibly according to the students' needs.
requiredKnowledge: Programming skills, especially the Python language, are required. The lecturer will use Mac OS, although Windows and Linux are acceptable. If you have any concerns about the execution environment of your program, please consult with the lecturer in advance.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain basic technology in intelligent information processing.
Be able to understand various techniques for natural language processing.
Be able to implement various natural language processing algorithms and build their application systems.
Be able to evaluate application systems based on various natural language processing algorithms.

achievementLevels.ideal: In addition to the standard level of achievement, the student will be able to understand the issues involved in the content there. The student should also be able to construct an applied system of natural language processing that combines basic technologies.
achievementLevels.standard: The student should be able to understand most of the material covered in each lecture and be able to answer typical exercises related to that material with most accuracy.

lessons.content: Basic principles and progress of neural networks - Basic principles, modeling, learning framework (vs. reinforcement learning), back-propagation, and why deepening was achieved.

Past and future of natural language processing - Introduction and handling of morphological analysis (ex. Mecab), synonym database (ex. wordnet), Vectorization (ex. word2vec), development to transformers (overview of major papers).

Realization of dialogue systems using large language models (LLMs) - Creation of programs using large language models. - Creation of dialogue systems combining speech recognition and speech synthesis.
Devising a service using the dialogue system and creating a prototype for its realization 1 - How to proceed with group work to create innovation. - Creation exercise and presentation.
Differences from human language systems - Systematic understanding of human language by experimental semiotics. - Origin and evolution of language, Shared intentionality and hierarchy.
Devising a service using an dialogue system and creating a prototype for its realization 2 - How new technologies gain trust. - Creation exercise, Presentation.
Is artificial intelligence a tool or a partner? - Human agency and responsibility. - Criteria for determining whether an artificial intelligence is a member of our moral community.
